films.title: The Rule of Jenny Pen
films.overview: Confined to a secluded rest home and trapped within his stroke-ridden body, a former Judge must stop an elderly psychopath who employs a child's puppet to abuse the home's residents with deadly consequences.

films.title: Coming Home in the Dark
films.overview: A school teacher is forced to confront a brutal act from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters takes him and his family on a nightmare road-trip.

films.title: The Whisper Man
films.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.
